versions.content: InternalBehavior of a NvBlockSwComponentType to en- able access to the NVRAM Block management API In general, the InternalBe- havior of a NvBlockSwComponentType is only used for a limited scope. The main use case is that the NvBlockSwComponentType defines PPortProto- type s typed by a ClientServerInterface to enable access to the NVRAM Block management API. To enable the configuration of the server invocation in the RTE's ECU configuration, the NvBlockSwComponentType needs to provide the following model elements: • OperationInvokedEvent s • server RunnableEntity • PortDefinedArgumentValue s to define the NVRAM Block ID which has to be passed to the NvM In addition to the above list further model elements may qualify; the details are ex- plained in [TPS_SWCT_01584].
